notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
The distance at which a character crashes when falling has been increased. The number of deaths from falls will now decrease.


 Character control has been changed.


 The jump height has been increased.


 Changed the character's behavior in space to make it smoother and more comfortable.


 Interacting with spheres has become more intuitive.


 Rethinking some of the obstacles and challenges.

notes.title: The release has taken place!
notes.notes:
Get ready for a difficult challenge. Overcome all obstacles and get to the top without a single fall.
I wish you an enjoyable time in Sky Sojourn!

notes.title: Release is coming!
notes.notes:
Hello, friends! 
I'm glad to share the long-awaited news with you: the game is getting ready for release! Starting from December 7, 2023, you'll be able to immerse yourself in a world of new adventures and unexplored possibilities.

You can expect a wide variety of islands, obstacles, and a lot of falls. Test yourself and try to reach the top.
I can't wait for you to dive into the world of Sky Sojourn
